## Peach Melba (G4)

**Who she is.** A background Earth-pony mare at the Rainbow Falls Traders Exchange in *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic*, season 4 episode 22, **“Trade Ya!”** (catalogued around 1:33). She has a very pale cream coat, golden-yellow braided mane, warm orange-brown eyes, and is pictured with a hair bow and saddlebag. She's a recognizable fairground extra, not a featured trader. [G4 pony catalogue](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Earth_ponies)

**Name and continuity.** “Peach Melba” is a **fan/wiki identification**, not a verified spoken or credited G4 name. An archived screencap was sourced from a wiki file labeled `UEM2_ID_S4E22.png`; that filename is an image identifier, **not proof of a studio production name**. I couldn't verify who first coined the nickname or any official G4 merchandise name. Separately, a **G5** background pony received the *same proposed name* in [Equestria Daily’s 2021 community naming results](https://www.equestriadaily.com/2021/11/name-this-pony-naming-background-ponies.html); that does not establish an identity or continuity connection.

**Speaking and appearances.** Her documented G4 appearance is the crowd at the *Trade Ya!* exchange; no specific spoken line, voice actor, secret identity, or further credited role was verified. A definitive on-screen cutie mark was not established by the checked sources.
